top_signals.title: How AI is Transforming China's Economy
top_signals.summary:
CICC Chief Economist and former China State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE) official Yanliang Miao reacts to the August economic activity data released by Beijing. He also discusses AI's impact on the economy with David Ingles and Yvonne Man on "Bloomberg: The China Show."
 (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Tata Sons’ Listed Shareholders Rally After RBI Renews IPO Push
top_signals.summary: Tata Group companies with minority ownership of Tata Sons Pvt. jumped following Indian banking regulator’s refusal to exempt the conglomerate’s holding entity from a rule that requires it to go for a public listing.
